findings.description: The retry now runs for any weak question once there is any earlier user turn, because the refers_to_previous_turn gate was removed. It also no longer skips previous questions that got NO_CONTEXT_ANSWER.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a conversation where the user asks an on-topic question, then a standalone off-topic question such as 'what is the capital of France?' whose retrieval is weak. Mechanism: line 58 retrieves with the earlier question prepended, which is the behavior the removed docstring said to avoid, so unrelated context is supplied to the model. Impact: the model can answer from irrelevant handbook passages instead of abstaining, producing a misleading answer.
